title: Four in a Row: gravity placement + line detection
description: Two players drop discs into columns, gravity pulls to lowest empty row. Four in a line (horizontal/vertical/diagonal) wins. Validates: constrained placement (column-based, gravity fill), line detection on larger board (7x6), draw on full board. Trivial extension of tic-tac-toe's line-detection pattern. Small definition, exercises the engine with a different board topology than tic-tac-toe.
close_reason: Delivered games/four-in-a-row.json and python/tests/test_four_in_a_row.py. 6 tests pass (gravity, column-full, vertical win, horizontal win, diagonal win, draw). CEL win detection blocked on baize-935.1; win tests use standalone oracle. Draw detection via occupied_count==cell_count fires correctly through CEL.
